|notes=This is the numbered white-on-black presentation of Black 2 (V). The Players Committee distributed it as Virtual Set #1a through Decipher. Both numbered PDFs record creation on 6 March 2002 and state tournament legality from 9 March. The numbered sheets print collector mark 1•9 with identical words and game values in the two ink layouts. Other editions include [[Black 2 (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Original unnumbered)|Original (unnumbered)]], [[Black 2 (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Numbered black-on-white)|Numbered (black-on-white)]], [[Black 2 (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Premium)|Premium]], [[Black 2 (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Remastered 2006)|Remastered (2006)]].
|sources=* [[Media:Decipher-Virtual-Set-1a-numbered.pdf|Numbered Virtual Set #1a source PDF]], [[Players Committee]], distributed through [[Decipher]], page 1, collector label 1•9. The numbered white-on-black slip supplies the game text and any covered statistics. The article image is a direct rasterized crop of this source sheet.
* [[Media:Decipher-Virtual-Set-1-numbered.pdf|Numbered Virtual Set #1 source PDF]], page 1, collector label 1•9, for the same wording and numerical values in the black-on-white print option.
* Lore, destiny, upper-card attributes and other uncovered information: the printed Premiere [[Black 2]], [[:File:Premiere-D-black2-decipher-archive.gif|Decipher source face]]. The Virtual slip replaces the covered portion only.
